steps.content: The blue light emitted by the shackles dims. The Corpus, torn apart by the Black Ring itself, finally has its true form revealed—a huge, ugly, and ferocious monster.

steps.speaker: Corpus
steps.content: You despicable □□□, lacking her strength, you resort to such a low trick...

steps.speaker: Corpus
steps.content: I will never be defeated by this... I've gained power, reclaimed what's mine... I will not go down here...

steps.speaker: Corpus
steps.content: Lowly insect! You'll never trample over me!

steps.speaker: Corpus
steps.content: Whoaaaa!
Hey, Chief... Finally caught up with you.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: I've brought a new friend to you. This is gonna get much more exciting.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Hmm, you don't look so well.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That was some sterling acting from you just now.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Hahaha, all I did was do you a favor and give you some encouragement. Look how well it turned out.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: I said I'd catch up with you and I just wanted to meet an old friend. Did I lie? Haven't I kept my promise?

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: What else did I say? Right, I also said we'd destroy the Black Ring together, the three of us.
The severely weakened monster is still struggling to escape.

steps.speaker: Corpus
steps.content: No... it can't end here... I must find that woman... I must kill her... I want revenge...

steps.speaker: Corpus
steps.content: If she couldn't kill me, nor can you... I'm stronger then ever... I won't die here...

steps.speaker: Corpus
steps.content: Right, all I need to do is abandon this vessel and find another one... go into hiding, slowly gather strength, just as I did last time... You won't be able to find me... No one will...

steps.speaker: Corpus
steps.content: I must survive... survive and then come back... and then...
(CG Scene: The Corpus sees an apparition of Julien, trapped.)

steps.speaker: Corpus
steps.content: ...It's you. Why are you still here? You...

steps.speaker: Corpus
steps.content: Ahhhhh!
The architect doesn't answer. Right at that moment, a thunderous roar issues from the Black Ring High Tower. The ground under your feet starts shaking, rising rapidly.
One minute, the High Tower was on the verge of collapse; the next, it is high in the sky, trapping the fleeing Corpseborne in an inescapable aerial cage.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Yeah... The Paradeisos Rules are no longer in effect. The monster is still clinging to life. We suppress it, the three of us; don't let it run away.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: And...

options: We let the Syndicans take care of the rest.
